content: The term nuclear watch officer refers to a specific role within the nuclear field, often associated with responsibilities in overseeing nuclear operations. Similarly, Nuclear Machinist Mate (abbreviated as MM), Electrician's Mate (abbreviated as EM), and Electronics Technician (abbreviated as ET) are enlisted ratings within the nuclear domain. When these enlisted personnel take promotion exams, their ratings are denoted with an N to signify their nuclear specialization. The term Nuke can have various meanings depending on the context. In the realm of computing, Nuke may refer to a denial-of-service attack. Specifically, WinNuke was an exploit targeting certain early versions of Microsoft Windows. In the warez scene, Nuke has a distinct meaning related to the unauthorized distribution of software. In the context of role-playing games, Nuke refers to a specific gaming-related concept. Nuke is also the name of a digital compositing software developed by The Foundry, widely used in visual effects and post-production. Additionally, Nuke can describe a family of simple content management systems (CMS) that provide basic functionalities such as user management and news item editing. These systems can be extended with additional features, such as calendars and forums, through the use of modular add-ons.
